Mid-morning, a toast to the care lead
The new month is here
Smooth Departures for Companion Pets

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping the handoff process calm, clear, and consistent. Staff should continue to confirm carrier fit, label checks, and document review before each handover, while keeping a steady tone for travelers who may be anxious about the journey. Simple reminders help keep the desk organized and the boarding flow easy to follow. When a case needs extra attention, use the normal stepwise review and pass it along without delay.

Travelers benefit most when our guidance is direct and practical. Keep the focus on welfare, clear updates, and careful coordination with the wider airport team. A tidy desk, a patient approach, and clean records all support smoother movement for pets and their owners. Companion Animal Travel Desk
